name: DBOS
summary: DBOS is an open-source library that adds durable workflows, queues and schedules to an application by checkpointing workflow and step state in Postgres. There is no separate orchestration server: the library runs inside your process and recovers interrupted workflows from the database. DBOS Conductor is an optional control plane for monitoring and managing workflows.
facts: In-process library, no orchestrator to run
Open-source library free; paid DBOS Pro tooling and support
watchOut: Throughput is bounded by your Postgres
